title: Inventory writes failing
summary: inventory-db writes began failing while read traffic remained healthy

logs: inventory-db ERROR no space left on device writing WAL
deployments: backup-agent retention changed from 14 to 90 snapshots at 07:55Z

runbooks.title: Database disk exhaustion
runbooks.content: When database writes fail with no space left, inspect retained snapshots and disk growth. Remove safe obsolete snapshots and restore retention limits.

oracle.root_cause: Excess backup snapshots filled the inventory database disk, preventing WAL writes.
